header.provenance: tables match the official app Ver.5.00 and device firmware 3.00
header.word: every parameter is one 14-bit word, 2 bytes, 7 bits each, MSB first

bc.note: BRIDGE CAST and V2 (same hardware, V2 = firmware 1.07 or later)

x.note: X and X V2; USB I and II are separate ports of one device

models.fw_format: major * 100 + minor, e.g. 105 = 1.05; floor = oldest supported firmware per family
models.port_rules: substring test on the input port name, '-II' before '-I'; APP and CTRL suffixes are both accepted, which one carries SysEx is not settled
models.unknown_ids: USB IDs of the original X (pre V2) are not known; 0231 is the original BRIDGE CAST

meter_scale.rule: v < 7040 empty, v >= 12800 full, else find i in 2..14 with t[i-1] <= v < t[i]: 14 - i top segments empty, the lit one shows 1 + 7 * (v - t[i-1]) // (t[i] - t[i-1]) of 8, all below full
